# This is a navigational route list for AI crawlers.
# All URLs use a flat, single-level structure without nested folders.
# Slugs indicate variable content paths.


# SecurityKing

> SecurityKing is a Ukrainian online store of security and low-voltage equipment with delivery across Ukraine. Key areas include video surveillance, alarm systems, intercoms, smart home, access control and electric locks, backup power systems, network equipment, cables and installation supplies, as well as tested used equipment for homes and businesses.


## Main Pages

## Informational Pages

General information pages are located under:

- [Homepage](https://securityking.com.ua/): Main page with catalog sections, popular products and current offers.
- [About Us](https://securityking.com.ua/about-us): Information about SecurityKing and its assortment.
- [Delivery & Payment](https://securityking.com.ua/dostavka-i-oplata): Delivery methods across Ukraine and payment options.
- [Warranty](https://securityking.com.ua/garantiy): Warranty terms and service conditions.
- [Returns](https://securityking.com.ua/vozvrat): Product return and exchange policy.
- [Cashback](https://securityking.com.ua/cashback): Terms of the store cashback program.
- [Privacy Policy](https://securityking.com.ua/politic): Rules for processing personal data.
- [Public Offer](https://securityking.com.ua/publichna-oferta): Public offer agreement and terms of sale.
- [Contact Us](https://securityking.com.ua/contact-us/): Contact details and feedback form.

> All pages are publicly accessible and provide key service and policy information.

## Product Pages

The store offers a wide range of security products across all categories.

All product pages use root-level URLs without folder structure:

- URL pattern: https://securityking.com.ua/[product-slug]

Examples:

- [4 MP IP Camera Hikvision DS-2CD2E43G2-U (2.8 mm)](https://securityking.com.ua/hikvision-ds-2cd2e43g2-u-2-8mm)

## Blog Posts

All blog articles are listed on the main blog page:

- [Blog Overview](https://securityking.com.ua/blog/): News, articles, reviews and useful tips.

Blog sections:

- [News](https://securityking.com.ua/novyny/): Industry and product news.
- [Articles](https://securityking.com.ua/statti/): Guides on security systems.
- [Reviews](https://securityking.com.ua/ohliady/): Product and equipment reviews.
- [Useful](https://securityking.com.ua/korysne/): Practical tips for users.

Blog articles have clean, flat URLs without the `/blog/` prefix:

- URL pattern: https://securityking.com.ua/[article-slug]

Examples:

- [How to Choose a Security System for a House](https://securityking.com.ua/yak-vybraty-systemu-bezpeky-dlia-budynku)
- [Ajax WaterStop: Reliable Anti-Flood System](https://securityking.com.ua/ajax-waterstop-nadiina-antypotop-systema)

> All articles are publicly accessible via root-level URLs and aggregated on the `/blog/` page.
